snippet.title: Under Review - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Under Review is an anomaly-hunt horror game. Inspect uncanny hotel rooms, document discrepancies and survive the strict, unforgiving bureaucracy of the Manager.

Wishlist on Steam here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4836150/Under_Review/
